hill_meeting_yield — DRIVE pass op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hill_meeting_yield(ego_direction: 'str', *, ego_refuge_distance: 'Optional[float]' = None, other_refuge_distance: 'Optional[float]' = None, near: 'float' = 30.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivepass; drivepass.hill_meeting_yield(ego_direction: 'str', *, ego_refuge_distance: 'Optional[float]' = None, other_refuge_distance: 'Optional[float]' = None, near: 'float' = 30.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("hill_meeting_yield"))

Usage

Passing each other at a narrow spot on a slope: who yields (Rules of the Road (Kyosoku) 6-2-1(6). No explicit statutory provision). Scenario S128.

In principle the downhill car yields to the uphill car (because starting on an uphill slope is difficult). However, if there is a passing place near the uphill car (near, assumed within 30 m), the uphill car pulls into it and waits. ego_direction = "up" / "down", *_refuge_distance = distance from that car to the passing place ahead (None if there is none). Returns: yielder ∈ {"ego", "other"}, where ∈ {"refuge", "stop"}, basis.
